title: Add a todo statistics endpoint
probes: A capability with no UI surface at all. The PO should label it `be`, and the visual gate should find nothing to check.
description:
As someone watching the todo list I want a machine-readable summary so that I can graph it later.

Add `GET /api/todos/stats` to the web server returning JSON with: `total`, `done`, `open`, `overdue`, and `by_priority` (counts for high/normal/low). It must honour the existing `tag` query parameter so the stats can be scoped the same way the list is.

No change to the HTML page and no new CLI command.
